manifest: FACTORY-F01-IMPL-01 bounded C-F01 PAPER canary cohort pack
assignment: Codex ruling issuecomment 6513808658 (parallel implementation; only activation waits)

parity_contract.head: d255b3fbd91bff689f699869256b2f8e96f6d98a
parity_contract.rule: the parity contract governs; this pack only operationalizes it. A contract amendment that changes bounds, preconditions or pins supersedes this pack

environment: PAPER / Binance Futures testnet only. Never mainnet, never MODE / LIVE_CONFIRM, never credentials

shape.on: true (exactly the JSON boolean) = ON; anything else = OFF
shape.start_utc: tz-aware ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, frozen by Integration at authorization, before any scored bar is read
shape.cohort_dir: absolute evidence directory OUTSIDE the repo, or null (extracts disabled)

flag.testnet_guard: honoured only when Engine.live is False AND the trading client base URL is exactly binance_client.TESTNET; otherwise every new C-F01 entry is refused and logged (S7, fail closed)
does_not: enable C-F01 (its SLEEVES enabled flag stays Integration's switch)
flag.code: f01_canary.py; engine.py Engine.f01_canary_block (called from Engine._rules_block, automatic entries only), Engine.f01_canary_preflight, Engine._f01_extract / _f01_decision (observe-only hooks in miss, _audit_opened, _measured_close, _measured_followup)
flag.pinned_functions_untouched: none of the 34 functions pinned by the parity contract is edited (re-hash test in tests/test_factory_f01_impl01.py)

bounds.counting: C-F01 rows opened AND closed at / after start_utc (a pre-canary lot is never counted)
bounds.drawdown_basis: cumulative measured net R (row_view measured / acknowledged pnl / risk_usd) from a 0 R start; the peak includes 0; drawdown = max(peak - cum)
bounds.pending_rule: any counted C-F01 close with pending costs (row view, or the durable candidate_cost_pending index) blocks new C-F01 entries until measured (fail closed)
bounds.on_reach: new C-F01 entries refused with the bound text; open lots keep confirmed protection and normal management; nothing is force-closed (OQ8)

frozen_start_rule: Integration writes start_utc once, in the same settings change that sets on=true, only after preflight.pass is true; it is never moved. Before start_utc the gate refuses new C-F01 entries
scoring_start_rule: OQ2: >= 250 older closed 4h bars are warm-up only. Scoring starts at the first fully closed 4h decision bar after BOTH the authorization and a successful preflight; a runtime decision is marked scored when its bar open time >= start_utc (the whole bar lies after the frozen start)

preflight.call: Engine.f01_canary_preflight(head_sha=<running head>, pins_expected=<pins_expected below>) -> {pass, checks{ENV, C1, C1b, C2..C10}, recorded}
preflight.pass_rule: every check ok; C9 needs the head SHA and every pin to match; C10 needs authorization_comment_id and start_utc

clean_cohort_record_template.reset: candidate-flat (C1): no C-F01 / C-F02 lot or pending / resting / unconfirmed / deferred entry; no pre-canary lot imported
clean_cohort_record_template.notes: no order, trade, stop or client ids

rollback.owner: Integration only (Build and Evidence never edit settings)
rollback.command: On the PAPER bot only, through its own settings path with the bot running: SLEEVES[id == 'C-F01'].enabled = false (one field). No installer, no restart, no MODE / LIVE_CONFIRM change. Turning F01_CANARY.on off is NOT a rollback (it removes the bounds)
steps: R1 Integration sets the C-F01 slot enabled = false
R2 open C-F01 lots are not closed: they keep confirmed exchange protection and normal signal / stop management (OQ8)
R2b force-close only for unknown account state, lost / unrestorable protection, environment uncertainty or a separately recorded safety decision
R3 after the next 4h cycle confirm: no new C-F01 entry, every open C-F01 lot has a confirmed stop (no stop_miss), C-F02 enabled false
R4 finalize the extracts with the stop condition id; Cowork publishes verdict.json

telemetry_checks_read_only: each 4h cycle: bot log lines 'FACTORY-F01 canary:' (logged once per distinct refusal reason)
settings: F01_CANARY unchanged since authorization; C-F01 enabled as authorized; C-F02 enabled false
state: candidate_disabled has no C-F01 entry (S1); no C-F01 lot with stop_miss_why restoring / owner_check (S3); no C-F01 candidate_cost_pending entry >= 6 h old (S4)
f01_canary.bound_status(cfg, history rows, candidate_cost_pending) -> closed, net_r, drawdown_r, stop (S5 / S6)
cohort_dir/extracts/*: each file name equals the sha256 of its bytes (ExtractWriter.records verifies)

stop_conditions.S2: a MUST-MATCH parity divergence (incl. P13 C-F02 activity)
stop_conditions.S5: 4.0 R measured net drawdown from the canary peak (runtime gate)
stop_conditions.S6: 30 calendar days or 8 closed C-F01 trades (runtime gate)
stop_conditions.S7: mainnet / live / credential / non-testnet event (runtime gate refuses)

evidence_outputs.runtime_extracts: extracts/{decision,trade,preflight}/<sha256>.json - canonical JSON (sorted keys, ASCII, non-finite floats as {"float": "nan"}), written once (exclusive create); the same bytes again = no-op, different bytes = error
evidence_outputs.finalize: ExtractWriter(cohort_dir).finalize() -> preflight.json, decisions.csv, trades.csv, MANIFEST.sha256 ("<sha256>  <name>" per line); each file written once
evidence_outputs.not_by_build: verdict.json (Cowork, OQ7); the rp_* / causal_window_id / result columns stay empty in Build's CSVs
evidence_outputs.deferred: frames_manifest.json (closed 4h frame sha256 per symbol) needs a hook inside the pinned compute_signals / cycle - open question Q1

open_questions: Q1 frames_manifest.json and the true raw qty / raw stop (P17 / P19 raw side) are computed inside pinned functions (compute_signals, open_lot, _create_lot). The extracts record the quantized values sent plus raw values re-derived from the lot inputs. Integration: accept derived raw values, or amend the contract pins for a minimal observe-only hook

Q2 the runtime gate is independent of the slot's enabled flag: with F01_CANARY absent, an Integration-enabled C-F01 trades without canary bounds (pre-existing behaviour). Should enabling C-F01 require the canary flag?
Q3 scored = decision bar open >= start_utc (the whole bar after the start); confirm this reading of OQ2
deferred: activation (needs Cowork PASS on #248 exact head + Integration authorization)
